en: Color postcard showing the Black Sea resort of Eforie Nord in Romania: a modernist seaside promenade with terraces, lawns and a sculpture park above a sandy beach with breakwaters and sunbathers. The reverse has Romanian text, an orange 40 bani stamp (R.P. ROMÎNIA), postmarks including București 29 dated 1.8.67, and printed credits such as EFORIE-NORD, Editura Meridiane, Arta Grafică, and Foto: H. Löffler.
